summary.text: Andy Biggs is the U.S. Representative for Arizona's 5th District, seeking the governorship with running mate Sine Kerr, a former state senator. He previously served in the Arizona House and Senate, including as Senate President, and chaired the House Freedom Caucus for two years.

paragraphs.text: Arizona native with a B.A. in Asian Studies from Brigham Young University, an M.A. in political science from Arizona State University and a J.D. from the University of Arizona; retired attorney.
Served eight years in the Arizona House and six years in the Arizona Senate, and was elected Senate President in 2012.
Elected to the U.S. House in 2016; chairs the House Judiciary Subcommittee on Crime and Federal Government Surveillance, sits on House Oversight, and co-chairs the Border Security Caucus.

sources.title: Arizona Republicans choose Rep. Andy Biggs to challenge Gov. Hobbs
